steps.en: Company email address is available before sending
steps.id: Alamat email company sudah ada sebelum email dikirim
steps.why_en: The address comes from stored data; the live lookup is switched off.
steps.why_id: Alamat berasal dari data tersimpan; pencarian langsung dimatikan.

steps.en: Batch job picks AN notices ready to notify
steps.id: Job batch memilih notice AN yang siap diberi tahu
steps.why_en: Some vehicle types and already-suspended ANs are skipped, and the schedule is switched off.
steps.why_id: Beberapa tipe kendaraan dan AN yang sudah ditangguhkan dilewati, dan jadwalnya dimatikan.

steps.en: Company owners are routed to email
Each unique company gets one email per batch
steps.id: Tiap company unik dapat satu email per batch
steps.why_en: Notices merge only when stage and due date match, and an AN can merge with a non-AN.
steps.why_id: Notice hanya digabung jika tahap dan jatuh tempo sama, dan AN bisa tergabung dengan non-AN.

steps.en: Email text comes from the AN template
steps.id: Isi email diambil dari template AN
steps.why_en: The template lives in the database; if it is missing the email is silently skipped.
steps.why_id: Template ada di database; kalau tidak ada email dilewati tanpa kabar.

steps.en: Email is sent to each company owner
steps.id: Email dikirim ke tiap owner company
steps.why_en: The send path exists but prod settings in the repo block it and the schedule is off.
steps.why_id: Jalur kirim ada, tapi pengaturan prod di repo memblokirnya dan jadwalnya mati.

steps.en: Send status is saved and failures retried
steps.id: Status kirim disimpan dan kegagalan dicoba ulang
